Name: Paul Optometrist Mod (Female Portrait Version Alpha)
Author: stealth720
Description:
I was bored one day and decided to play around with pixel art. So I provided two portraits of her. If you want to try it just replace the portrait of Paul with her's inside the Paul Mod folder. This is the alpha version just to test if people might be interested in seeing a female form of Paul. Thanks!

If I see interest in this mod I might finish the entire portrait replacement and sprites.

Best,
Stealth

Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3791]Popuri Mod[/url] if you are interested in a full character conversion of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3414]Paul the optometrist mod. [/url]﻿Popuri is one of the girls out of many in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3775]Ultimate Harem Mod[/url]﻿.

Downloads.Description: Drag into Paul Mod and replace Paul portrait.
